result.markdown: --- author: ChuckPR title: dplyR has a cume_dist function date: 2024-10-17 categories: ["tidyverse", "dplyr"] --- Useful for making [ECDF charts](https://ericmjl.github.io/blog/2018/7/14/ecdfs/) in combination with `geom_step`. ::: {.cell layout-align="center"} ```{.r .cell-code} suppressPackageStartupMessages( library('tidyverse') ) library('palmerpenguins') penguins |> group_by(species) |> mutate(cumedist = cume_dist(body_mass_g)) |> ggplot(aes(x = body_mass_g, y = cumedist, color = species)) + geom_step(direction = 'vh') + scale_color_brewer(palette = 'Set2') + theme_minimal(base_size = 16) ``` ::: {.cell-output-display} ![](index_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-1-1.png){fig-align='center' width=672} ::: :::
